title: Rent in Force on the Next Due Date for a Security Advance (Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement)
content:
**Pricing clause.** The advance month of a security advance on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is priced at the rent that will be in force on the next due date:

1. where a retention concession has been noticed with an effective date after the handling date, its new rent is used;
2. where no such concession is noticed and an existing-customer increase has been noticed with an effective date after the handling date, the increase's new rent is used;
3. otherwise the contracted monthly rent is used.

The notices are read from the agreement's rent change history: the change reason (retention concession or existing-customer rate increase), the effective date and the new rent. An effective date after the handling date is a date later than the handling date itself.

## Which rent applies

| Retention concession effective after the handling date | Existing-customer increase effective after the handling date | Rent used |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | the concession's new rent |
| no | yes | the increase's new rent |
| no | no | the contracted monthly rent |

## Hypothetical cases (handling date 20 March, contracted rent $150.00)

- Increase to $165.00 noticed, effective 10 April; concession to $157.50 noticed on it, effective 10 April: the rent used is $157.50.
- Increase to $165.00 effective 10 April, no concession: $165.00.
- Increase to $165.00 that took effect 10 February: neither notice is effective after the handling date, so the contracted monthly rent, $150.00 on the record, is used.
